Name: Stardew Valley First Person (POV)
Author: tepemert
Description:
[center][b]Description[/b][/center]
Stardew POV brings a first-person perspective to Stardew Valley, placing the camera at your farmer’s eye level. Explore your farm, walk through Pelican Town, enter buildings, and use your tools while looking around with the mouse.
The mod uses Stardew Valley’s existing pixel art to create perspective environments, reconstructed buildings, interiors, furniture, and scenery. Tool actions, inventory, dialogue, and collisions use the game’s own systems.
This is an experimental single-player mod. Some characters, plants, and decorations use sprite surfaces, and visual imperfections may remain. Custom maps, all home upgrades, extensive story events, and compatibility with other mods have not been fully tested.

[center][b]Installation instructions[/b][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Close Stardew Valley.[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] if you haven’t already.[/*]
[*]Download and extract the main Stardew POV archive.[/*]
[*]Copy the [b]StardewPOV[/b] folder into your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder. The final path should be
[code]Mods/StardewPOV/manifest.json[/code].[/*]
[*]Launch the game through [b]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/b] and load your save.[/*]
[/list]POV starts enabled. Press [b]F5[/b] to toggle it and [b]F6[/b] to release or recapture the mouse.
You can adjust settings in
[code]Mods/StardewPOV/config.json[/code]while the game is closed. To uninstall, close the game and remove the [b]StardewPOV[/b] folder.
[b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*]First-person camera with mouse-look and camera-relative WASD movement.[/*]
[*]Visible swords, tools, food, and drinks with action animations.[/*]
[*]Perspective buildings, interiors, furniture, doors, and fences.[/*]
[*]Seasonal pixel textures drawn from the original game.[/*]
[*]Day/night skies, moving clouds, rain, and snow.[/*]
[*]Upright beach vegetation, raised timber and rocks, and a reconstructed rowboat.[/*]
[*]Detailed pier supports and raised stone bridge parapets.[/*]
[*]Doors, gates, chests, and the repaired beach bridge follow their native game state.[/*]
[*]Adjustable mouse sensitivity, field of view, eye height, render distance, and head bob.[/*]
[/list][center][b][b]Requirements[/b][/b][/center]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley on PC — tested with [b]version 1.6.15[/b].[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.5.2 minimum[/b] — tested with version 4.5.2.[/*]
[*][b]Single-player mode[/b] — POV is disabled in multiplayer.[/*]
[/list]Windows is the verified platform. Other operating systems and game versions have not been tested. Minigames retain their original view.
[b]Shout outs[/b]
Thanks to [b]ConcernedApe[/b] for Stardew Valley and its wonderful pixel art, [b]Pathoschild and the SMAPI contributors[/b] for the modding tools,
Designed and directed by [b]Mert[/b], with AI-assisted coding and testing through [b]OpenAI Codex[/b],
Textures are read from the player’s existing game installation at runtime. No AI-generated artwork is included.
